answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Every claim climbs the falcon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the wharf re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The trellis of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
